spec2def(url.dll url.spec)

list(APPEND url_rc_deps
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/102.ico)

# url.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/url-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(url_shims OBJECT url_main.c)
target_link_libraries(url_shims PRIVATE wine libshell32 libshlwapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(url_shims)
add_cargo_module(url url-cargo url.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS url_shims psdk)
